test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: ______ is the sole authority prescribed in the Indian Constitution entrusted with the responsibility of audit of receipts and expenditure of the Union and each State and the Union Territory Governments.

options.text: Comptroller and Auditor General of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Comptroller and Auditor General of India.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• As the head of the **Indian Audit and Accounts Department**, the **Comptroller and Auditor General of India** is a pillar of the country's democratic system of government.
 
• He oversees the nation's whole** financial system** at both the** state and central levels** as the protector of the public purse.
